results.title: Wisry : Clone the ads already winning in your market, at scale
results.content:
That said, if you pick a source ad aimed at a totally different buyer, the skeleton might just not fit. That's why the research step ranks ads from your own market first. And if something's off, you don't re-edit by hand. You tell the agent in chat what to change, say "make this speak to first-time buyers, not repeat customers", and it rewrites that part while keeping everything else consistent: the script, the scene timing, the captions, the product claims. Is there a specific case you're thinking of?

Ruta Jaskunaite

Hey Product Hunt 👋

I’m a co-founder of Wisry. I spent years on the other side of this problem, watching good ecommerce teams burn budget guessing at ad creative and eventually got annoyed enough to build the thing that fixes it.

The problem [...] The problem

Every ecommerce team runs the same loop: brief a creative, wait a week, launch the ad, watch it flop. Rework the hook, relaunch, burn more budget. By the time something finally sticks, the trend has moved on.

What kept bugging me is that the winning ad usually already exists. It’s running in your market right now, and a competitor is paying to prove it works. That’s a research problem, not a creativity problem, but everyone keeps solving it with more creativity.

⚡ What we built

Wisry is an autonomous execution layer for paid ads. You give it your store, and its AI agents run what we call a Campaign Run:

- Competitor Intel: reverse-engineers the ads already winning in your market

- Research-based angles: hooks and messages, each with the evidence behind it [...] 🙏 What I'm hoping for today

Honest feedback, not upvotes. If you run ecommerce ads, tell me where this would break for your niche, or the one thing that would make it a no-brainer for your stack. That's the input that shapes what we build next.

The whole team is in the thread today, @alireza\_ghods1 @kazzv @m\_mahini, our engineering, product, and growth leads, so throw us the hard questions.

I’m here all day. You can also reach me at ruta@wisry.ai.

And a huge thanks to @jonnotie for hunting us, and to the Product Hunt team and community for having us. 👇

Nika
